method: Server/db/query_perf_bench_test.go on its synthetic 400k-message database. The nightly job in nightly-test-depth.yml runs it at dev and at ref, interleaved on one runner, and Server/scripts/bench/bench-gate.mjs fails on more allocs/op than below or a median ns/op over 20 % above ref.
update: A PR that lowers allocs lowers allocsPerOp here; a PR that speeds a query up moves ref to its own merge base so the next regression is measured from the faster code. goalNsPerOp is the Phase Q4 target, reported only.
